title: Psalms 56
paragraphs: ¹ Be gracious to me, O God, for people are hounding me — they press against me and fight me all day long. ² My enemies pursue me all day long; many are attacking me, O Most High. ³ When I am afraid, I put my trust in you. ⁴ In God, whose word I praise — in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can mere flesh do to me? ⁵ Every day they twist what I say; all their thoughts are bent on hurting me.

⁶ They huddle together, they lurk in the shadows, watching my every step, waiting to take my life. ⁷ Can they escape by their wrongdoing? In your anger, bring the nations down, O God. ⁸ You have kept count of all my wandering; collect my tears in your bottle — are they not recorded in your book? ⁹ When I cry out to you, then my enemies will turn back — this I know, for God is on my side. ¹⁰ In God, whose word I praise — in the LORD, whose word I praise.

¹¹ In God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can anyone do to me? ¹² I am bound by the vows I made to you, O God; I will offer you my thanks. ¹³ For you have delivered my life from death — and surely my feet from stumbling — so that I may walk before God in the light of life.
